newsitem.title: USA: Riser Foods, Giant Eagle say HSR pd expires.
newsitem.headline: Riser Foods, Giant Eagle say HSR pd expires.

text.p: Giant Eagle Inc and Riser Foods, Inc said Wednesday the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 applicable to Giant Eagle's tender offer for Riser Foods has expired and accordingly that condition to the consummation of the transaction has been satisfied.

The company said this applies to the pending cash tender offer by Giant Eagle's wholly-owned subsidiary, Talon Acquisition Company, to purchase all outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock of Riser Foods, Inc. at $42.00 net per share. The offer and withdrawal rights, which commenced May 20, 1997, will expire midnight, New York City time, on Tuesday, June 17, 1997, unless the offer is extended.
